messages:
tess: Quick concept  'Community Ignite'  two 10m tutorials + tiny OSS refapp + 30m bench demo. Goal: drive stars + signups.

omar: I can take the launch post and three social variants. Keep CTAs: 'Run in 10m' + star the repo.

julia: DevRel will scaffold a single-repo, Dockerfile, and a reproducible bench script (baseline + quantized). ETA 5 days.

tess: UTM pattern suggestion: utm_source=community_ignite&utm_medium={channel}&utm_campaign=ignite_launch&utm_content={variant} - reuse across all channels.

omar: For webinar landing, add form fields: Company size (dropdown) + "Evaluating inference infra?" (yes/no). Enterprise -> SDR; others -> nurture + trial invite.

julia: README run snippet: ```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/community-ignite.git
cd community-ignite
docker build -t ignite .
docker run --rm -e MODEL=mini ignite ./bench.sh --iters 30
```

tess: Action items: Omar - blog + social drafts; Julia - repo + CI; Tess - landing + routing + Asana epic. React with :white_check_mark: to accept.

omar: :white_check_mark:
